# nettle / fuzz_dsa_openssl_private_key_from_der

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `fuzz_dsa_openssl_private_key_from_der` ([source](source/fuzz_dsa_openssl_private_key_from_der.c), unmodified) over nettle (git.lysator.liu.se/nettle/nettle at bb9bba13).

dsa_openssl_private_key_from_der(&params, pub, priv, 0, size, data) with no size limit; the result code and the parsed values are discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against nettle at commit bb9bba13.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgmp.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgmp.a` (a library from the build image)
